This tendency can also affect relationships, leading to unnecessary scrutiny and a loss of trust. Rrajesh emphasised the importance of seeking constructive feedback without becoming dependent on reassurance, setting realistic stopping points for decisions and learning to accept uncertainty. Ultimately, she noted that knowing when to stop striving for perfection is as important as putting in one's best effort.
